name: Unicommerce Reverse ETL
shortInfo: Sync data from your warehouse to Unicommerce.
brief: Unicommerce provides a SaaS (Software as a Service) for complete warehouse management of big e-commerce companies.
about:
Unicommerce Reverse ETL sync enables streaming data from a user determined warehouse to Unicommerce platform in an automated manner.

Learn more about [Unicommerce API documentation](https://documentation.unicommerce.com/docs/saleorder-create.html).
availableSync:
[Create Sale Order](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/unicommerce/index.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve data pertaining to sale order creation, from a user specified data warehouse to the Unicommerce platform.

Learn more about the sync [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/unicommerce/index.html).
